name: 63080 · Sullivan, MO
findings: ZIP 63080 (Sullivan) has 43 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63080 (Sullivan) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 63080 (Sullivan) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 51% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
